bodyHtml:
FCSB 3 - 0 Spindles

Our first match-up against the CDSL leaders FCSB was one to forget.

Mostly playing in the Spindles half, a strong defensive effort from the Spins wasn't enough to get a result.

Spindles soaked in the pressure for the first half, going into the break level at 0.

However, a few lapses in the middle and back thirds gave FCSB more clear-cut chances in the second half.

Of those chances, 3 of them were put away throughout the rest of the match.

Final score ended at 3-0, FCSB.

A hard-fought match leaves Spindles feeling motivated to finish off the regular season strong and salvage a strong playoff seeding.

We will see you next week at 6:15 pm vs. Ligon FC.
